QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showHeadingCompassBar
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show a horizontal heading compass bar at the bottom center of Fly View.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showGimbalHeadingCompassBar
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show the active MAVLink gimbal direction at the top center of Fly View.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gimbalLegacyYawReference
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Shared by all MAVLink gimbals whose attitude feedback omits both yaw frame flags. Select the reference used by the reported yaw; displayed azimuth always remains relative to Earth North. Explicit yaw frame flags take precedence.
